hypothesis: Separate support/applicability assessment reduces false advice vs a combined score.
criterion: On validation: choose the mode with lower false advice at equal or better coverage; tie -> separate. (A null false-advice rate, no advice issued, is read as 0.)
outcome: false advice rate separate n/a vs combined n/a; eligible coverage separate 0.000 (0/5) vs combined 0.000 (0/5): tie on false advice and coverage -> separate (keeps targets identifiable).
